title: Enforce questions-only coaching in code, and trim what the conversation coach sends

source.ref: Review of the Codex AI coaching overhaul, 2026-10-26

detail: Coaching questions from the model were accepted if they merely ended in a question mark, so a question quoting replacement copy passed. The Space, writing and listing question parsers and the conversation coach now reject any question or check containing a double quote. The conversation coach no longer sends author names to the vendor, the Space coach profile fields pass through the same cleaning as the About text before they reach the prompt, legacy model-drafted winback proposals no longer block a fresh proposal for the same member, and two importer review strings no longer promise a mood picker that was removed. Left open: the discovery consent write is a read-modify-write that two quick toggles could interleave.

verify.note: Exits 0 once the question parsers reject quotes and the transcript carries no author names.
